Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J37/J37nB371.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Foyuan. Foyuan Chegang owns the retained deployment: welcomes the masters who have flocked in to shore up the ancestral seat, lifts his whisk, and traces the patriarch seal handed down by the sages of the transmission right into the mountain monk's hand, asking the assembly whether they can trust it and what tune this is.

Senses.Explanation: The sages of the transmission as one line, and the masters who lean on it or shake it. Xuedou Chongxian sets Deshan's case aside and puts the where-do-the-sages-go question straight to his own assembly, driving them out with blows when they hesitate, Ciming Chuyuan runs the lineage's samadhis down the line with each sage unknowing the next and draws one circle with his staff, Foyan Qingyuan opens his abbacy by tracing the sages of the transmission through this one gate from Vulture Peak to the Second Patriarch, Yuanwu Keqin writes to a trainee that what everyone already has inside the shell of ignorance is not shifted by a hair from the sages of the transmission, and Dahui Zonggao at the great memorial rite runs them through the whole ladder of non-abiding, from descent into the womb to the seat under the bodhi tree. Yushan Shangsi brings his staff down once and points at that very place as the bodhi terrace where the sages of the transmission blew the great conch and turned the great wheel, Jiqi Hongchu grades the whole line as endlessly conferring and still hunting the shortcut, and Foyuan Chegang lifts his whisk and traces the patriarch seal handed down by the sages of the transmission right into the mountain monk's hand.
